fact: The January 2022 TADAT assessment states the e-SISIC portal has allowed online filing since 2019 for all taxpayers under the real regime but is little used, with 2020 e-filing shares of 25.4% (corporate income tax), 25.5% (personal income tax) and 0% (VAT), and electronic payments at 19.5% by number and 1.8% by value.
title: Rapport d'Évaluation de la Performance - République du Niger
